methods.name: GeoState
methods.description: A view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation.

methods.name: Scene Tokenizer
methods.description: Aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state.

methods.name: Geometry Decoder
methods.description: Queries the scene state using camera rays to reconstruct a depth map.

methods.name: Autoregressive World Model
methods.description: Predicts future scene states using a sliding four-state context.

methods.name: Camera Prediction Model
methods.description: A separately trained model that predicts future camera trajectories.

methods.name: VGGT-Ω
methods.description: A geometry foundation model used as a backbone for GeoState to extract geometry-aware features.

methods.name: Perceiver-style Tokenizer
methods.description: Used by the Scene Tokenizer to aggregate variable-length memory into a fixed-length scene state.

methods.name: Masked Factorized Transformer
methods.description: Architecture adopted for scene-state prediction within the Autoregressive World Model.

methods.name: VGGT-World
methods.description: A prior 3D world model that forecasts future VGGT features.

methods.name: FR3D
methods.description: A prior 3D world model that predicts the latent state of a pretrained 3D reconstruction model while modeling ego-motion separately.

datasets.name: Waymo
datasets.description: A large-scale dynamic driving scenes dataset used for in-domain evaluation.

datasets.name: KITTI
datasets.description: A driving dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation.

datasets.name: nuScenes
datasets.description: A driving dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation.

metrics.name: Depth Forecasting
metrics.description: Evaluation of the model's ability to predict future scene geometry.

metrics.name: Mean Absolute Log-Depth Error (Llog D)
metrics.description: Measures the mean absolute log-depth error over valid pixels for geometry reconstruction.

metrics.name: Local Depth Gradients (Lgrad)
metrics.description: Supervises local depth gradients during geometry reconstruction training.

concepts.name: 3D World Modeling
concepts.description: The goal of learning to predict how the physical world evolves in a geometrically grounded state space.

concepts.name: Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs)
concepts.description: Models that provide strong pretrained priors for multi-view 3D perception by learning rich geometric representations.

concepts.name: View-decoupled Geometry State
concepts.description: A geometry representation that separates scene content from how the scene is observed, making it independent of the observation viewpoint.

concepts.name: Scene Dynamics
concepts.description: The genuine physical evolution and changes within a scene.

concepts.name: Camera-induced Variation
concepts.description: Changes in a representation caused by camera viewpoint shifts, rather than actual scene evolution.

concepts.name: Scene State
concepts.description: A compact representation of the underlying 3D scene geometry.

concepts.name: Viewpoint Coupling
concepts.description: A limitation in GFM features where changes in camera viewpoint induce substantial changes in the representation, even if the scene is static.

concepts.name: Geometric Priors
concepts.description: Strong geometric knowledge captured by large-scale pretraining that generalizes across scenes and tasks.

concepts.name: Scene Coordinate System
concepts.description: A shared coordinate system used to express multi-view geometry and maintain consistency across timestamps.

concepts.name: Camera Rays
concepts.description: Plücker ray fields constructed from a query camera's intrinsics and pose, used for geometry decoding.

concepts.name: Cross-view Querying
concepts.description: The ability to query the same scene state from different viewpoints to obtain consistent observations.

concepts.name: Zero-shot Generalization
concepts.description: The ability of a model to perform well on new, unseen datasets without explicit training on them.

concepts.name: Scale Alignment
concepts.description: The process of ensuring consistent metric scale across different frames or predictions, which GeoState avoids needing per-frame.

findings.name: GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo in depth forecasting.
GeoState supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying.
GeoState generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes.
GeoState maintains a consistent scale throughout the forecasting rollout without per-frame scale alignment.
View decoupling makes the scene representation more predictable.
View-decoupled geometry states derived from pretrained GFMs are an effective representation for predictive 3D world modeling.
Viewpoint coupling in GFM features is a limitation when using them as predictive world states.
